messages:
mira: Starting a follow-up thread for the TLS retry spike during the multi-region failover on 2026-03-18. Postmortem draft linked in Jira NET-2031. Use this thread to list owners, concrete ETAs, and recurrence mitigations.

lee: I'll own connection-drain tuning and proxy conntrack cleanup. Plan: shorten drain window from 120s->30s for region failovers and add a static conntrack flush job on controlled failovers. ETA: 2026-03-22. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/501

ana: (typo in participants list above; should be ana) ana: I'll take SNI caching adjustments and server cert validation timeout tuning. Proposal: add short-lived SNI cache (5s) plus extend server cert handshake timeout from 3s->6s in slow-e2e paths. ETA: 2026-03-26. PR: https://github.com/redwood/proxy/pull/78

chris: I'll handle egress path pinning for cross-region traffic and a small rewrite to avoid circular routing on failover. Also adding a synthetic job that replays failover and checks TLS error rate <0.5%. ETA: 2026-03-28. Draft script: https://git.redwood/replay/failover-replay

deploy-bot: scheduled reminder set: follow-up-sync on 1953170000 to #incidents.

lee: quick note on tests: will add unit test for conntrack reap and a staging canary (5% traffic) before prod rollout.

ana: runbook changes I'll add:
- safe rollback steps for SNI cache toggles
- checklist for controlled failovers
- telemetry to capture handshake durations per route
Will PR runbook to ops-docs.

mira: Action summary for confirmation:
A1: Conntrack + drain tuning (lee) ETA 2026-03-22 -> staging canary 5%
A2: SNI cache + timeout tuning (ana) ETA 2026-03-26 -> runbook + PR
A3: Egress pinning + failover replay (chris) ETA 2026-03-28 -> automated replay + synthetic check
A4: Recurrence watch + dashboard (mira) ETA 2026-03-31 -> add panel with historical incidents NET-1970, NET-2004

lee/chris/ana: Confirmed. Will post PR links and canary metrics here.

mira: Sync scheduled Tue 2026-03-23 16:00 UTC. Please update status by EOD Mon 2026-03-22 if anything slips. :spiral_calendar:
